title: Chanan the Egyptian
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: According to the Gemara, Ketubot 105a, he was one of the judges of decrees in Jerusalem in Temple times, with Admon and Chanan, and he is not mentioned in the Mishnah. In Yoma 63a: “Chanan the Egyptian says: Even if the blood is in the cup, he brings its fellow and pairs it.” Hyman distinguishes another Chanan the Egyptian who lived in the time of Rabbi Akiva and his colleagues, as in Sanhedrin 17a: “They discussed before the sages: Shimon ben Azzai, Shimon ben Zoma and Chanan the Egyptian.”
